entries.note: The air waybill is issued; the goods are not handed over yet.
A flight manifest records an assignment before the departure, so it keeps the stage before it.
The pieces are loaded onto a pallet or container for a flight before it departs, so it keeps the stage before it.
Pieces come off a pallet or a planned flight, often to be built up again for the same or a later flight, so it keeps the stage before it.
The pieces are unloaded from the flight's pallets at the arrival station.
Taken over from another airline at a transfer.
Handed to another airline at a transfer.
A delivery away from the destination, or before the tracker marks the waybill delivered, stays in transit.
A recorded delivery is reversed and the goods are back at the cargo terminal.
